draft_context.source_title: Amnezia VPN now supports human rights defenders with free premium VPN subscriptions
draft_context.description: Amnezia VPN and Civil Rights Defenders teamed up to protect free speech Journalists, activists can ask for free access to Amnezia Premium VPN NordVPN and Surfshark previously introduced similar initiatives Amnezia VPN has partnered with independent non-profit organisation Civil Rights Defenders to provide free access to Amnezia Premium for journalists and activists. It’s not the first time the anti-censorship VPN has helped the category. Indeed, Amenzia VPN previously partnered with NGOs to support more than 300 journalists and activists from countries with heavy censorship — including Venezuela, Turkey, Russia, and Myanmar. We all love the best VPNs to hide our real location, prevent our internet provider and third-party marketing companies from tracking us, or to protect our data when we connect to public Wi-Fi networks. However, as regulators and platforms tighten their grip on freedom of digital access and the freedom of online expression itself, professionals writing about censorship or human rights violations and digital rights require reliable digital tools more than ever — particularly when they are located in countries with heavy internet censorship. "Through this program, we hope to reach even more people," Amnnezia said. In the meantime, its free service Amnezia Free continues to serve 2.5 million monthly active users for free in heavily censored countries, as the VPN continues to strengthen its commitment to protecting digital freedom by recently unveiling new anti-censorship protocols. How to apply for the Amnezia VPN and Civil Rights Defenders program The program is open to independent professionals and media organisations covering topics including freedom of expression and digital security, or that live and work in countries subject to censorship, media restrictions or state surveillance. It will provide annual subscriptions to Amnezia Premium service — which, during our testing, has delivered impressive unblocking and access to 20 global server locations — with the option to renew the subscription for longer periods. There is currently no deadline for applications, and the program is expected to remain in place for at least one year. To apply, professionals can complete a form if they have an email address linked to a specific project. Alternatively, they can contact Civil Rights Defenders by sending a description of their work and some references to vpn@civilrightsdefenders.org. Signal contact is also available upon request. You can find all the information in this blog post . 📝 Are you a journalist or activist covering human rights, censorship, or cybersecurity? Amnezia VPN has teamed up with Civil Rights Defenders to offer sponsored Amnezia Premium subscriptions for secure connection & digital protection. Apply now: https://t.co/G8z10U6uEh… July 28, 2026 Mazay Banzaev, founder of Amnezia, emphasised that journalists and human rights defenders' work is vital to society. "Supporting them is part of what we consider our mission," he said. In this context, the partnership with Civil Rights Defenders is ideal, as the organisation operates in over 50 countries and provides a range of digital support and security services, including legal assistance, temporary relocation and digital protection measures to enable human rights defenders to continue their work. "Civil Rights Defenders partners with human rights defenders in some of the world's most repressive environments to ensure that those who work for democratic rights and freedom of expression have the right tools to minimize risks imposed by isolationism and censorship," said Sofia Walan, Executive Director of Civil Rights Defenders. The partnership adds to previous collaborations between other VPN firms and non-profit organisations, reflecting a growing awareness and desire for new initiatives aimed at combating digital threats. Earlier this year, NordVPN partnered with Internews to boost digital protections for journalists and activists by directly integrating NordVPN ’s security tools and 'Changemakers' training sessions into Internews' global digital security programmes. Surfshark had also previously collaborated with the same organisation to provide fully funded Surfshark One subscriptions to 100 media outlets and civil society organisations operating in nine high-risk countries. ]]>

Who is it best for? Power users and administrators who value deep configurability over simplicity, and want robust malware protection, an excellent VPN, and granular security controls. Who shouldn’t buy it? Casual Mac users seeking a simple, set-and-forget antivirus, or anyone who needs flawless reliability, polished interfaces, and bug-free compatibility with every application. At a glance Protection: ★★★★☆ Performance: ★★★★☆ Features: ★★★★☆ Ease of use: ★★★☆☆ Value: ★★★★☆ ESET takes a focused approach to Mac security. Rather than attempting to bundle every imaginable system utility into one package, it concentrates on antivirus protection, phishing prevention, spam filtering, ransomware protection, identity protection, and a surprisingly feature-rich VPN. For this review, I tested ESET Home Security Ultimate with the bundled ESET Cyber Security antivirus (at version 9.0.6700.0) on macOS Tahoe 26.6, evaluating malware detection, VPN performance, phishing protection, system performance and overall usability. While the software delivers excellent protection and impressive configurability, several software bugs prevent it from reaching its full potential. Find out how ESET compares to the best Mac Antivirus apps in our group test. What’s included with ESET HOME Security? The ESET HOME Security subscription is available in Essential, Premium and Ultimate tiers. Essential includes the core Mac security features: antivirus and anti-malware protection, anti-phishing protection and Wi-Fi security. Premium builds on Essential with additional security features, although the review focuses primarily on the Ultimate tier rather than detailing every Premium-exclusive capability. Ultimate adds ESET VPN with VPN for Router support, Identity Protection and Ransomware Remediation. How good is the ESET Cyber Security malware protection? An ESET Cyber Security scan in progress . Foundry Antiviral and anti-malware features have long been ESET’s bread and butter, and there was plenty to be impressed with here, even if its presentation could have used some improvement. A full scan of a local SSD with more than 800GB of data was completed in roughly four hours. The scans ran well in the background, and the application quickly and quietly removed suspect files as they surfaced, disabling the vast majority of malware before it became executable. Throughout testing, ESET Cyber Security removed and/or quarantined more than 95% of the 130-plus malware samples tested. It quietly deleted suspect files in the background with little interruption to the user, helping to stop threats before they could cause damage. During testing it also allowed pseudo versions of popular applications such as Discord, Xcode and Transmission to be copied into the Applications folder, although macOS Gatekeeper and XProtect prevented them from launching. Not every threat was completely eliminated. ESET allowed parts of the Conduit, CrateDepression (decimal.rs), DevilRobber, FinSpy, Inqtana, JacksBot, KandyKorn, Rubilyn, ShaiHulud and XCodeSpy malware samples to remain or launch development files. However, its overall detection rate was strong, and its antivirus and anti-malware protection dovetailed well with macOS Gatekeeper and XProtect, proving as effective as anything I had tested. How good is the VPN? Choosing between protocols in ESET VPN . Foundry The VPN client , which comes with the ESET HOME Security Ultimate tier, came out swinging and didn’t let up. The client came loaded with a healthy selection of VPN protocols that could be switched on the fly, including WireGuard, IKEv2, UDP, TCP, Stealth and WStunnel. During performance tests it streamed and downloaded well, offered easy geolocation switching, and delivered performance on par with many standalone VPN clients. An impressive set of proxy and LAN settings geared towards routers offered auto-connect and Kill Switch features, while VPN for Router support extended protection beyond the Mac itself. The VPN implementation is one of the suite’s strongest features, providing a wide range of protocols, extensive configuration options, and performance comparable to dedicated VPN software. How good is the phishing protection? ESET Cyber Security’s anti-spam and anti-phishing features weren’t perfect, but they were still impressive and helped prevent the worst elements of an email’s spam folder from ruining the day. The filter caught most of the questionable links that were clicked, including casino links, purported Cash App payment scams, farm equipment discounts and other suspicious content. The filter still allowed access to purported solar refund sites and ED medication pages claiming to be endorsed by Bill Gates. Even so, its performance proved more reliable than some competing products, and the feature conveyed the feeling that it would stop the worst of the junk and phishing attempts from coming back to haunt you. Is ESET easy to use on a Mac? ESET Cyber Security’s copious Settings menus, which can be used to fine-tune the application . Foundry ESET Cyber Security was fairly easy to install. After downloading, the application requested Full Disk Access along with kernel and network extension permissions to complete its setup. Once installed, it focused on a simpler set of tools than many competing security suites, concentrating on antivirus and anti-malware protection, a VPN client, and phishing and spam protection rather than trying to include every possible system utility. The software proved straightforward to use day to day, with scans running well in the background and suspect files being quietly removed as they surfaced. However, its extensive array of settings made it particularly well suited to experienced users. The settings allowed control over almost every aspect of the software, including whitelists, malware tolerances, network functions and actions taken when questionable files were found. This administrator-level functionality offered exceptional flexibility, although it could feel unwieldy for casual or home users. ESET Cyber Security’s Help & Support section may not offer the hippest interface in the universe, but it worked well and generally got the job done. Quick links from the home screen to the company’s help page, knowledge base and technical support sections addressed a good variety of general questions. One omission is worth noting. The software lacked a quick link to ESET’s YouTube channel, which is full of useful tutorials. This seems like a quick fix waiting to happen, and offering handy links as needed could only make this section of the software stronger. Foundry ESET Cyber Security performed smoothly and reliably and there was little noticeable impact on the Mac during testing. The software ran well in both the foreground and the background, and, with the exception of a Discord compatibility issue, played nicely with everything on the test Mac. The antivirus and anti-malware scans weren’t the fastest the I’ve seen, but they were still quick, thorough and unobtrusive, and none of the background functions appeared to take a noticeable toll on system performance. The full scan of a local SSD containing more than 800GB of data took about four hours, during which time ESET Cyber Security removed and/or quarantined more than 95% of the 130-plus malware samples tested. During performance tests the VPN streamed and downloaded well, offered easy geolocation switching, and supported a wide range of protocols including WireGuard, IKEv2, UDP, TCP, Stealth and WStunnel. The VPN’s performance and feature set is on par with many standalone VPN clients. However, several bugs prevented it from feeling completely polished. The Scheduler function failed during multiple tests, the VPN required a macOS certificate to be reauthorized before it would work correctly, scan logs lacked useful detail and convenient export tools, and the software prevented Discord from updating and launching successfully, sending the application into an infinite loop that required the Mac to be rebooted to stop. How we tested Testing was performed on macOS Tahoe 26.6 using real-world malware detection, VPN evaluation, phishing protection, background performance analysis, and overall usability testing. What holds ESET back While ESET Cyber Security performed well overall, there were some bugs to work out. The antivirus and anti-malware scan interface could have been more informative, lacking an elapsed timer, percentage complete readout and estimated time until completion. The scan logs were also limited, failing to clearly identify what malware had been detected or its potential effects, and there were no convenient import or export tools. A macOS certificate had to be reauthorized before the VPN would work correctly, and the Scheduler function failed during multiple tests. The most significant compatibility issue occurred with Discord, as ESET Cyber Security prevented the application from updating and launching successfully, sending the process into an infinite loop that required the Mac to be rebooted to stop. These bugs detracted from an otherwise powerful and highly configurable security suite. Clearly there is still some work to do. How much does it cost and which ESET HOME plan should you buy? The branding is a little confusing because, historically, you could purchase ESET Cyber Security as a standalone Mac antivirus application. ESET HOME Security Premium Adds ESET LiveGuard cloud threat analysis and premium protection features. Starts at $79.99 for 1 device for 1 year ESET HOME Premium isn’t great value for Mac users because some of its features are Windows only. ESET HOME Security Ultimate Adds VPN, VPN for Router, Identity Protection and Ransomware Remediation, alongside the core antivirus and anti-phishing features Starts at $179.99 for 5 devices for 1 year HOME Security ultimate is a good option if you want a premium VPN with your antivirus and want to protect more than one device. Should you buy ESET HOME Security with ESET Cyber Security for Mac? ESET HOME Security rings all the right bells, offering antivirus and anti-malware protection that dovetailed well with macOS Gatekeeper and XProtect, and, if you opt for the Premium or Ultimate tier, an impressive VPN client. Its extensive settings and level of customization made it particularly well suited to advanced users and administrators who wanted granular control over their security environment. While several bugs prevented it from feeling completely polished, there was still plenty to like. Take advantage of the free 30-day trial , which requires no payment information, to see whether ESET Cyber Security is the right fit for your Mac.

Look for at least USB 3.0, which has a speedy bandwidth of 5Gbps compared to the lamentably sluggish USB 2.0’s 480Mbps. To fast-charge an iPhone, you need a minimum of 18W and it has to be USB-C , so look for extra USB-C slots with charging power, which are more capable than USB-A. Other ports to look for in a hub include Ethernet for faster wired Internet access (without the flakiness of Wi-Fi). You can choose from standard Gigabit Ethernet (1000Mbps) or 2.5Gb and even 5Gb and 10Gb Ethernet (2500-10000Mbps), although the faster Ethernet requires the whole network to support that speed. An SD or microSD card reader is perfect for adding inexpensive portable storage to your system. Card readers come at different speeds: UHS-I at 104MBps, and UHS-II at 312MBps; although some are slower at 60MBps. Look for hubs that offer passthrough charging , so you can charge your laptop even though you are using up one of the laptop’s USB-C ports for the hub itself. Most don’t ship with a charger, so you’ll need to add your own, and remember that it needs to be a 100W charger to give 85W and above charging if offered by the hub. Lower wattage chargers are fine but will limit the hub’s charging potential. Couple your hub with one of the best Mac USB-C chargers . See how much power your MacBook needs in our advice below the list of recommended hubs and adapters. You can also buy USB-C adapters for the many older display standards out there, such as VGA and DVI . We’ve picked the best for you below. Many hubs and docks aren’t compatible with Apple’s SuperDrive CD/DVD drive. We’ve found few dock makers that offers compatibility with the SuperDrive, the Caldigit Thunderbolt Element Hub and OWC Thunderbolt Dock being two that do. Which ports does each Mac have? Here are the onboard ports on all of Apple’s current and recent Macs: MacBook Neo: 2x USB-C (one for 10Gbps data and one for charging), 3.5mm headphone jack MacBook Air: 2x Thunderbolt 4, MagSafe 3 charging port, 3.5mm headphone jack MacBook Pro (plain M4/M5): 3x Thunderbolt 4, MagSafe 3 charging port, HDMI, SDXC Card Reader (250MBps), 3.5mm headphone jack MacBook Pro (M4/M5 Pro/Max): 3x Thunderbolt 5, MagSafe 3 charging port, HDMI, SDXC Card Reader (250MBps), 3.5mm headphone jack iMac (24-inch): 2x Thunderbolt 4/USB4 or 4x Thunderbolt 4, 3.5mm headphone jack, optional Gigabit Ethernet Mac mini M4: 3x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB-C (10Gbps), HDMI, Gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm headphone jack Mac mini M4 Pro: 3x Thunderbolt 5, 2x USB-C (10Gbps), HDMI, Gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm headphone jack Mac Studio M4 Pro: 4x Thunderbolt 5, 2x USB-C (10Gbps), 2x USB-A (5Gbps), HDMI, 10Gb Ethernet, SDXC Card Reader (312MBps), 3.5mm headphone jack Mac Studio M3 Ultra: 6x Thunderbolt 5, 2x USB-A (5Gbps), HDMI, 10Gb Ethernet, SDXC Card Reader (312MBps), 3.5mm headphone jack Mirrored or Extended Modes for Mac displays When you attach more than one external display to a Mac you can choose between various setups. Most hubs with more than one video port—usually HDMI—can mirror your MacBook’s screen, but most can at best handle showing a different screen to the Mac but not different to each other when attempting Extended Mode. For full extended Mode, where each of the screens shows a different image and you treat each as an extension to your workspace—moving your cursor and windows easily between the displays—you will likely need a hub or dock that supports free third-party DisplayLink software, which is easy to download and install. Included above are reviews of the Plugable Dual and Quad HDMI adapters, both of which work with DisplayLink. DisplayLink enables multiple screens even with plain M1 and M2 MacBooks that are technically limited to just one external display. If you need even more ports than you’ll find on a hub, check our reviews of the best DisplayLink docks . Baseus How much power does each MacBook require for smooth running Check the Power Delivery (PD) charging power each hub or adapter offers connected laptops or iPads. The MacBook Neo charges at 20W. The 13in MacBook Air charges at 30W. The 13in and 14in MacBook Pro and 15in MacBook Air charge at 67W. The higher-end 14in and 16in MacBook Pro require at least 96W. The 16-inch MacBook Pro prefers 140W. You can certainly use a charger at lower power, but remember that it will power up slower than when using a higher-wattage charger, and if too low your laptop might run out of juice altogether when maxed out on power-hungry apps and devices. Most of the products tested here work with non-Apple USB-C laptops too, but you can read Tech Advisor’s more general roundup of the best USB-C hubs . Also, read our roundups of recommended USB accessories: • Best USB-C to Lightning cables • Best USB-C and Thunderbolt cables • Best USB-C power chargers
paragraphs: USB-C and its Thunderbolt variant are the most up-to-date standards of the USB connector. They allow data-transfer speeds of up to 80Gbps, can fast-charge devices up to 240W, and conveniently fit in a port either way up—which means that you can wave bye-bye to the age-old USB guessing game of “Which way does it go in?”.

USB-C is no one-trick pony—handling data transfer, video output and power input. You’ll find faster variants of USB-C (called Thunderbolt 3, 4 or 5) on Macs. Each version of Thunderbolt is backwards compatible with USB-C so the adapters reviewed here will all work with modern Macs—from the MacBooks Neo, Air and Pro, through to the desktop iMac, Mac mini and Studio. USB-C’s 5-10Gbps speeds will limit some of Thunderbolt’s more impressive 40 to 80Gbps potential but for most people even 5Gbps is fast enough. If super-fast data transfer is one of your requirements, a number of hubs reviewed below do use Thunderbolt or 40Gbps USB4. Find out more in our Thunderbolt 5 vs Thunderbolt 4 vs Thunderbolt 3 comparison and also our chart at the end showing all the ports of Apple’s recent Macs.

In general, an “ adapter ” works with a single port (such as USB-A or Ethernet) while a “ hub ” gives you multiple ports. If you require even more, then look for a “ docking station ” or “ dock “. Docks usually come with their own power supply, while hubs require a separate USB-C charger if you need a power source. If you’re after a full desktop setup for your MacBook, look out for our recommendations for the best USB-C and Thunderbolt docking stations for MacBooks .

Apple sells its own range of USB-C adapters to HDMI, VGA and more, but they are overpriced and underpowered compared to the premium USB-C hubs and adapters we have reviewed here. We haven’t included the many much cheaper but lower-quality versions you can find online as we recommend only from trusted and tested makers.
Passthrough power will likely also be of interest to MacBook users. 60W Power Delivery (PD) will work even for the 16-inch MacBook Pro (just), but more watts equals a faster charge.

articles.title: Google bắt tay Zalo, 80 triệu người dùng Việt Nam hưởng lợi
articles.summary: Trong khuôn khổ hợp tác, hai bên ra mắt Trang thông tin Trung tâm an toàn nhằm hưởng ứng Ngày An ninh mạng Việt Nam 06/08. Tín hiệu từ GenK Tin ICT cần được đặt vào bối cảnh trước: thời điểm xuất hiện, chi tiết đã có cơ sở và lý do nó đáng nằm trong dòng tin công nghệ hôm nay.

articles.hook: Điều cần theo dõi: Câu hỏi tiếp theo là tín hiệu này có thành rollout bền vững, thay đổi giá trị sản phẩm, giới hạn đáng chú ý hay chỉ là một nhịp cập nhật ngắn.

sections.heading: Bối cảnh: điều gì vừa đổi
sections.body: Trong khuôn khổ hợp tác, hai bên ra mắt Trang thông tin Trung tâm an toàn nhằm hưởng ứng Ngày An ninh mạng Việt Nam 06/08. Mục đích của Trang thông tin hướng đến việc tổng hợp kiến thức, công cụ và hướng dẫn người dùng chủ động nhận diện, phòng tránh các hình thức lừa đảo trực tuyến ngày càng tinh vi. Tín hiệu từ GenK Tin ICT cần được đặt vào bối cảnh trước: thời điểm xuất hiện, chi tiết đã có cơ sở và lý do nó đáng nằm trong dòng tin công nghệ hôm nay. Phần này cần dựng lại thay đổi đã có cơ sở trước khi chuyển sang nhận định.

sections.heading: Tác động thực tế với người đọc
sections.body: Kết hợp sức mạnh công nghệ từ hệ sinh thái Google và khả năng tiếp cận hơn 80 triệu người Việt của Zalo, Trung tâm an toàn được xây dựng như một cẩm nang an toàn số dành cho người Việt. Không chỉ cung cấp kiến thức nền tảng, trang thông tin hướng đến việc nâng cao nhận thức giúp hình thành thói quen bảo vệ bản thân và gia đình. Tác động thực tế nằm ở workflow, chi phí, rủi ro hoặc quyết định mua/dùng; Google bắt tay Zalo, 80 triệu người dùng Việt Nam hưởng lợi nên được giải thích qua lăng kính đó trước khi kết luận rộng hơn. Phần này cần nối câu chuyện với workflow, chi phí, bảo mật hoặc quyết định dùng/mua của người đọc.

sections.heading: Chi tiết cần kiểm chứng
sections.body: Bên cạnh đó, chiến dịch còn giới thiệu hệ thống giải pháp bảo mật đến từ cả Google và Zalo nhằm hỗ trợ người dùng chủ động phòng vệ trong các hoạt động hàng ngày trên môi trường Internet. Câu hỏi tiếp theo là tín hiệu này có thành rollout bền vững, thay đổi giá trị sản phẩm, giới hạn đáng chú ý hay chỉ là một nhịp cập nhật ngắn. Phần này chỉ giữ chi tiết có thể kiểm chứng và tránh lặp lại nguyên văn cách diễn đạt của nguồn.

sections.heading: Ai nên hành động hoặc chờ
sections.body: Được thiết kế với nội dung trực quan, ngôn ngữ gần gũi và dễ tiếp cận, trang Trung tâm an toàn hệ thống lại các hình thức lừa đảo phổ biến hiện nay. Từ đó, hướng dẫn cách nhận diện, xử lý và áp dụng các biện pháp bảo mật phù hợp. Với người đọc, khung hữu ích gồm bằng chứng hiện có, nhóm bị ảnh hưởng, rủi ro còn lại và điểm nên kiểm tra trước khi hành động. Phần này cần gọi đúng nhóm độc giả nên hành động ngay hoặc nên chờ thêm xác nhận.

sections.heading: Điều cần theo dõi tiếp
sections.body: Các kịch bản và quy trình lừa đảo trực tuyến phổ biến như lừa đảo tình cảm, đầu tư; mạo danh cơ quan nhà nước hay gửi tập tin, link có chứa mã độc để tấn công người dùng được trình bày sinh động và dễ hiểu, giúp người dùng có thể nắm bắt thông tin nhanh chóng. Với mỗi hình thức lừa đảo, Trung tâm an toàn còn đưa ra các gợi ý hành động để người dùng có thể nhận diện các “bẫy” điển hình, chủ động bảo vệ cho bản thân và gia đình tốt hơn. Một bài tốt cần tách rõ sự kiện từ nguồn, tác động với người đọc và câu hỏi theo dõi để không giống bản tóm tắt link rời. Phần này nên khép lại bằng tín hiệu cần kiểm tra tiếp, không tóm tắt lại cùng một ý.
